## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_prompts.py` passes locally
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build_index.py` has been run (README index regenerated)
- [ ] The recipe names exactly one deliverable and its runtime
- [ ] All four reproducibility clauses are present (model, settings, input, acceptance)
- [ ] "Verify it worked" contains checks that can actually fail
- [ ] "Where it drifts" describes a real failure mode
- [ ] `verified` is set honestly (do not mark your own new recipe `tested`)
